objectives: Describe how Judah stood surety for Benjamin.
Explain Jacob's honesty about the returned money.
Explain the separation at Joseph's table.
takeaways: Judah said, of my hand shalt thou require him; let me bear the blame for ever.
Jacob would not keep what was not his: carry again the money, and be guiltless.
God Almighty give you mercy before the man: Jacob committed the outcome to the Most High.
The Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; America fashioned itself after ancient Egypt.
Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs.
